entities.name: NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Information element that indicates the algorithms to be used for ciphering and integrity protection in NAS signaling. It is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets.

entities.name: NAS security algorithms IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier field that identifies the NAS security algorithms information element.

entities.name: Type of ciphering algorithm
entities.description: Field that indicates the type of ciphering algorithm to be used for NAS signaling protection.

entities.name: Type of integrity protection algorithm
entities.description: Field that indicates the type of integrity protection algorithm to be used for NAS signaling protection.

entities.name: EPS integrity algorithm EIA0
entities.description: Null integrity protection algorithm indicated by bits 000 in the integrity algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS integrity algorithm 128-EIA1
entities.description: Integrity protection algorithm indicated by bits 001 in the integrity algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS integrity algorithm 128-EIA2
entities.description: Integrity protection algorithm indicated by bits 010 in the integrity algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS integrity algorithm 128-EIA3
entities.description: Integrity protection algorithm indicated by bits 011 in the integrity algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS encryption algorithm EEA0
entities.description: Null ciphering algorithm indicated by bits 000 in the ciphering algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS encryption algorithm 128-EEA1
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm indicated by bits 001 in the ciphering algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS encryption algorithm 128-EEA2
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm indicated by bits 010 in the ciphering algorithm field.

entities.name: EPS encryption algorithm 128-EEA3
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm indicated by bits 011 in the ciphering algorithm field.

relations.description: The NAS security algorithms information element contains the IEI field as its identifier.
The NAS security algorithms information element contains the ciphering algorithm type field.
The NAS security algorithms information element contains the integrity protection algorithm type field.
The ciphering algorithm field value 000 indicates the use of EEA0 null ciphering algorithm.
The ciphering algorithm field value 001 indicates the use of 128-EEA1 ciphering algorithm.
The ciphering algorithm field value 010 indicates the use of 128-EEA2 ciphering algorithm.
The ciphering algorithm field value 011 indicates the use of 128-EEA3 ciphering algorithm.
The integrity algorithm field value 000 indicates the use of EIA0 null integrity protection algorithm.
The integrity algorithm field value 001 indicates the use of 128-EIA1 integrity protection algorithm.
The integrity algorithm field value 010 indicates the use of 128-EIA2 integrity protection algorithm.
The integrity algorithm field value 011 indicates the use of 128-EIA3 integrity protection algorithm.
